programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you get married, you look forward to a life filled with love, happiness and security. But what if you find out your spouse has been telling you lies and is someone completely different than the person you thought you knew?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Children accuse their dad of neglect.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests haven't even been married a year and are already wondering if it’s time to call it quits.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What’s a woman to do when her spouse is constantly standing over her shoulder and nitpicking everything she does? Michelle says her husband, Jim, has controlled her for the 15 years that they’ve been together, and she’s fed up with his faultfinding. She says he tells her what to wear, how much she should eat, and even uses a GPS to track her whereabouts! Jim admits that his behavior is out of control and fears that he could be pushing his wife out the door. Why is he so critical of Michelle, and can Dr. Phil get the judgmental hubby to change his ways? Then, Sally says her husband, John, is so controlling that she spends most of her days picking up dust bunnies from the floor and only speaking when he allows her to. John says cleanliness is next to godliness and believes control is a matter of perception. See what causes him to go toe to toe with Dr. Phil! Will the couple get the help they’re seeking? It’s an explosive Dr. Phil you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One man says he caught his wife cheating – on audiotape – but she denies the accusations. Who’s really telling the truth? Dr. Phil gets to the bottom of the alleged affair on tape. Can this relationship survive without trust?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Sugar Babies
programme.desc: Rylee, 26, admits she’s a sugar baby and says she has no shame in dating wealthy, married men she meets online in exchange for money and lavish gifts -- and three years ago, she even convinced her mother, Tanya, to join her. Dr. Phil sits down with this mother/daughter sugar baby team, who insist they never have sex with their clients. What “services” do they say these men are paying for? And how does their family feel about their lifestyle? Then, Ashley admits she has had a side job as a sugar baby for years but has yet to tell her fiancé, Cesar -- and she wants Dr. Phil to help her confess. How will Cesar respond? And, reality TV star Kendra Wilkinson opens up about her husband, Hank Baskett’s, alleged affair with a transsexual. Does she believe the rumors? And, can her marriage survive the turmoil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know someone who likes to pass the buck, point fingers and play the blame game, instead of taking responsibility and apologizing? Dr. Phil's guests are ready to confront a loved one who refuses to say they're sorry.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is There a Predator in the House?
programme.desc: As a parent, you're likely to be concerned about sexual predators who could potentially gain access to your child. But what if you suspected a child molester were living under the same roof as your child or grandchild? Dr. Phil tackles the stories of two concerned moms.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pamela says in just nine days, she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations with their children. Pamela says she believes Justin is a dangerous narcissist who she claims has locked the kids out of the house and attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Pamela says she will do whatever it takes to protect her kids from Justin, even if that means going to jail. Justin claims Pamela is a hateful, controlling, bitter ex, who has brainwashed their children into making up stories, and says Pamela’s claims of abuse are lies! These parents have been back and forth to court and claim nothing has been resolved. So, who is telling the truth? Is Justin an abusive father, or is Pamela a jealous ex making up stories for revenge? Can Dr. Phil get these parents on the same page for the sake of their children? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Meddling Mother-in-Law or a Lying Cheating Daughter-in-Law? Dr Phil delves into the family drama.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Dad Accused of Faking His Own Death
programme.desc: A man's claim of his father's disappearance leads to a shoking decption.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you rather be right or happy? Dr. Phil talks with some right-fighters who can't settle their debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda Knox spent four years locked in an Italian prison for the murder of her British roommate Meredith Kercher. Dubbed “Foxy Knoxy” by the press, she became one of the most famous cases of wrongful conviction. She tells her story, as she fights to save the life of Texas death row inmate Rodney Reed. This program contains graphic discussion about a criminal case. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Terrell Owens is a six-time NFL pro-bowler and arguably one of the best wide receivers to play the game, but he may be better known for his antics off the field. His tumultuous career has been well-documented, and he's been called arrogant, toxic and friendless. The football great sits down with Dr. Phil to set the record straight about the bad rap he says he’s been getting, especially from the mothers of three of his children, who claim he's also a deadbeat dad who is behind on child support payments and makes little attempt to see his kids. What does Terrell think of their accusations? See what happens when the moms come together to confront the alleged absentee dad on Dr. Phil's stage about missed birthday parties, ignored phone calls and empty promises. Is Terrell living in the lap of luxury while his kids go without? What kind of relationship does he want with his children? Dr. Phil delves into Terrell's past to help him create a better future for his children. Plus, at 38, will he play in the NFL again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica says she was instantly attracted to Jason, known as “Tank D.,” one of the stars of CMT’s hit show Redneck Island, and they started dating. But now, Jessica claims the man she loved for over 18 months is an arrogant, self-centered narcissist who cares more about partying and verbally trashing her than their 6-month-old baby son. Jessica says she believes this reality show "celebrity" is not only a deadbeat dad but an abusive, manipulating narcissist who is acting inappropriately with his female fans and firmly believes he cheated on her with Katie, a co-star from Redneck Island. Jason says Jessica knew he was wild from the start and failed to tame his bad boy ways. He admits he’s called Jessica names but adamantly denies he’s ever been physically abusive toward her. Jason says Jessica needs to stop using their son as a manipulative tool, because they are not together. Jason 100 percent denies cheating with Katie on season 5 of Redneck Island, but Katie says otherwise -- and in a shocking revelation, Katie reveals the full truth to Jessica. Will Jason continue to deny the affair or finally admit to cheating?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re not getting any younger, and the race is on to say “I do.” Sharon is 48 and says her biological clock is ticking away. She recently got engaged to a man whom she acknowledges is flawed, and she says her family doesn’t approve of her husband-to-be. Can she get them to accept her beau before they walk down the aisle, or do her relatives have a reason to be concerned? Then, Shea from the reality show Southern Belles: Louisville says that as she was planning her big day, she learned that her fiancé allegedly cheated. Now that the wedding is off, can Shea pick up the pieces and move on? Plus, a dating coach explains the biggest dating mistakes women make.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are deadbeat dads actually dead broke dads? As the American economy struggles, men comprise most of the recent layoffs. In child support cases, are men and women treated equally in the courts, or are the laws out of touch with today's crisis? Dr. Phil's guests, along with Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, and Lis Wiehl, author and legal analyst, debate the issue that has many men feeling like the laws are against them.

programme.title: Stepdads The Sketch- Ep 1
programme.desc: When infidelity claims the life of Joanne Bates, her children Lisa and Stevie are left in the custody of her fiancé Mike and his brother Jerry. Mike, a straight-laced, hardworking accountant; and Jerry, a wild, unstable, womanizer were both former foster children and together they provide a unique balance of parenting skills for young Lisa and Stevie. - Step Dads starring Ben Sloane (R.I.P.D, Alpha House), Morocco Omari (Empire, 21 Bridges, Homeland, Chicago Fire), Jorie Binion (Chicago P.D) Charles Dunlap (Chicago Fire, Empire), and Jay Davis (Not Another Black Movie, Choke On That: The Series, Not Another Zombie Movie) is a comedy about two polar opposite foster brothers raising two children using non-traditional parenting methods while shedding a satirical light on the importance of adoption. We poke fun at some of the mishaps which comes along with the shock of being a new parent, but ultimately, we hope to spread awareness on adoption, the importance of having fathers and father-figures in the lives of young people, and having a familial loving environment. The moral of our story is that “No family is perfect, but every child deserves to be loved unconditionally, and raised in a reliable, stable support system.”

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Plain Sight
programme.desc: Raven Harris is a woman with a plan. She's determined to create the life that she and her brother Rashon have been dreaming of, but someone is determined to not only turn her life into a nightmare but to end it.

programme.title: Messy
programme.desc: After being sent away to prison for possessing a firearm, Meek Richardson returns home to the DMV to find out his associate Kevin, is killed. Meek seeks to find the truth about his friend’s death, and finds that his enemies are closer than it seems.

programme.title: Kinfolk
programme.desc: Eboni, is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown. Her feuding family complicates her plans, but her dedication and drive, along with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Meanwhile, their estranged father's attempts to reconcile with his past create further challenges.

programme.title: Pretty Girls Kill
programme.desc: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty. 20 years later, now a detective, ghosts from her past resurface, and she must face these demons once again.

programme.title: Rhythm and Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: The Price of Fame
programme.desc: In the streets of Atlanta, Cassie, a struggling young woman searching for purpose, meets Ryan, a charismatic interviewer who offers her a chance to step into the world of fame and opportunity. With guidance from her cunning best friend, Ledrick, Cassie navigates the glamorous yet cutthroat entertainment industry. But as hidden agendas and betrayals emerge, Cassie finds herself questioning the cost of her dreams.

programme.title: Game of Cards
programme.desc: When data analyst Nicole Tucker’s car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she’s thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal. Her search for the truth uncovers a chilling connection between the theft and her boyfriend Michael, forcing Nicole to confront dark secrets, deadly allies, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

programme.title: Unintended Consequences
programme.desc: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother’s honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: The Good Sister
programme.desc: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin’s life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister—the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: The Co-Signer
programme.desc: Released from prison, Mark makes the decision to change his ways. Kane has other plans in store for him.

programme.title: The Forbidden Daughter
programme.desc: When tragedy happens at a young age Demetrius loses her way, until an angel comes to rescue her and gives her the strength to face her fears.

programme.title: Swing
programme.desc: In the gritty streets of 1945 Philadelphia, aspiring jazz musician and street hustler, Trip, dreams of a life-changing opportunity awaiting him in the vibrant world of Harlem. With three days until the audition, his journey takes an unexpected turn as he finds himself entangled in a web of corruption, vengeful gangsters, and the ominous presence of a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Conspiracy and Revenge
programme.desc: This episode deals with the murder of the glacier mummy Ötzi, the conspiracy against the Macedonian King Philip II and the assassination of the later first emperor of China.

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: Auschwitz One Day
programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

The trip will turn into an unpredictable and daring adventure, a symbol of an entire generation's desire for redemption.

programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: We visited Brabus, the largest independent automobile tuner where you can find more than 9,000 HP in one place. Also: MTM's Audi RS6 Clubsport.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Berlin-based company TH Automobiles equips Volkswagen vans with Porsche engines, turning a T5 into one of the most dynamic large saloon cars in the world.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Conti Tuning Day is themed "Power Sedans" and we take a closer look at the cars on display. Plus: Swiss eccentric Ueli Anliker has built the most expensive Mercedes-AMG SLR in the world, the "Red Gold Dream".

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Gemballa specialises in refining Porsche models, but its portfolio also includes brands such as Ferrari. And: the car tuning company Irmscher turns the Chevrolet Camaro into the 'Irmscher Camaro i42'.

programme.title: Porsche 550 RS Spyder
programme.desc: Small, lightweight, agile and swift as an arrow. Historic image documents of the Porsche 550 RS Spyder.

programme.title: BMW 750i xDrive

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What better way is there to celebrate a stylish and powerful car and a sunny summer day than going for a cruise over the Alps to Italy in a Maserati GranCabrio MC? In addition: a Brit with a fiery temperament, the Jaguar XK-RS convertible with 550 hp. And: Mercedes AMG's SL models, uncompromising performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: On Patrol with the Dubai Police

For the first time ever, the Dubai Police Special Cars Unit allowed a television crew to accompany them on their service missions.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Aerodynamics crucially influence the performance, track stability and dynamics of a vehicle. We took the Porsche 911 Turbo S, the BMW M6 convertible and the Kelleners 330d to the test and explored the influence of different wings and spoilers.

programme.title: Audi RS7 Sportback Performance

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6

programme.title: Trackmasters

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey sets out to build a nice hunting rig out of a 2012 GMC 4x4 truck. But this rig belongs to John Godwin of Duck Commander, which means the truck will be spending some serious time on the road… and off… hunting for ducks. On goes a 6” lift, 35” tall tires, and massive bumpers and winch to pull this big white beast out of any mud holes it may end up in. And since it IS such a big white beast, it is only fitting that Stacey name this project “Moby Duck”! If you’ve ever wondered if it’s possible to have a daily driver, that can also be a nice hunting, fishing, or outdoor rig. This episode of GEARZ will show you how to do it.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Super Car, Hot Rods, Go Carts
programme.desc: Stacey rolls the SL-C back into the shop to show off the twin turbo system Schwartz Performance installed. If you thought 1000hp out of an LS-7 was impossible, THINK AGAIN! Even wilder is the fact that this engine is pulling that kind of horsepower on pump gas! If supercars and twin turbos are your thing, you have to see this! After that, Stacey goes through some of the problem areas that you will face when you are building a vehicle and how to pick the right project. Finally He digs into the 1st motorized vehicle that most of us had…the Go-Kart. There's something for everybody in this show. That’s why they call it GEARZ!

Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon

Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Travel darling Krakow, Poland feels like a fairy tale with looming castles, medieval courtyards and even fire breathing dragons. But more modern history of the horrors of World War II and an occupation of communist rule did not leave Krakow unscathed. Today Krakow is a progressive and friendly city that invites travelers the world over to sample its layered history and many charms.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Prague, Czech Republic is simply awe-inspiring and firmly planted on the tourists’ trail. The Raw Travel crew digs deep to uncover underground charms by visiting with a variety of locals from diverse backgrounds as they showcase Prague’s culture and history like never before.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Romania’s capital city often gets short shrift as travelers passing through aren’t aware of its hidden, if sometimes gritty, charms. The Raw Travel crew, with the help of some savvy locals, shows them just what they’ve been missing.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: NYC Underground (Brooklyn & East Village)
programme.desc: The top of the heap for creative, eclectic arts is New York City. It’s time to take an alternative look at one of the most amazing cities in the world as Raw Travel stops in counter culture East Village, red-hot Williamsburg and iconic Coney Island, Brooklyn.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Transylvania is the fabled home of Dracula and the setting for all sorts of frightening, and mostly, fictional tales. Rob & crew uncover the real Transylvania on a road trip through striking landscapes dotted with old farmhouses and rural villages full of friendly folks, many who live as they did centuries ago.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: Bratislava, Slovakia & Vienna, Austria
programme.desc: Separated by less than an hour or so by boat via the famous Danube you’ll find two major cities that, though proximate to each other, could not be more different. Not long ago, Bratislava and Vienna were at the edge, but opposite ends of the fabled Iron Curtain, which divided much more than just ideology. The crew explores the resulting and fascinating contrasts recent history has imposed, but mostly, shows travelers how they can have a good time appreciating the very different charms of each city.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: One of Eastern Europe’s crown jewels and much traveled destinations, Budapest gets the Raw Travel treatment. The crew enlists the help of savvy locals and expats to uncover some of the more hidden and decidedly less touristic charms of Budapest.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: Bulgaria & the Black Sea
programme.desc: Rob and the Raw Travel crew road trip through Bulgaria to the Black Sea Coast where ancient history, contemporary adventure and some very good times await. But few adventures worth their salt come without tribulation. The crew’s resolve and resilience is tested as they overcome a major obstacle to continue their escapades through mystical and enchanted Bulgaria.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: New Orleans has much more to offer travelers than Mardi Gras and Bourbon Street. Rob returns for his first time post Hurricane Katrina to visit with long time locals and new transplants alike while discovering a surprising side of the Crescent City.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.sub-title: Raw Travel: Louisiana Road Trip (Cajun Culture)
programme.desc: The Raw Travel team crosses over the Mississippi river to see how locals on the West Bank and well outside the tourist zones of New Orleans really live. Then Rob and crew embark upon a road trip to head deeper into rural Louisiana among the bayous and swamps to experience the unique language, delicious food, sights and sounds of French inspired Cajun culture.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Raw Travel host, Robert Rose, was a young child during the U.S. and Vietnamese War, but the disturbing images never left his mind. Decades later, Rob visits Vietnam for the first time and discovers a culturally rich, diverse land that is on the move and welcoming travelers from all over the world, including the United States. Join the crew as they taste the unique gastronomy (snakes, frogs, etc.) and get a feel for centuries old traditions and culture.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Manila, the bustling capital city of the Philippines, is a perfect backdrop for Raw Travelers wishing to experience an alternative look at authentic Filipino culture. Rob and crew sample the delicious food and music while exploring the unique diversity of this exceptional Pacific Island nation. The crew meets a plethora of locals to get a real taste of the welcoming nature of Filipinos and learn why the Philippines is famous the world over for its unrivaled hospitality.

programme.title: Neven’s Greenway Food Trails
programme.desc: Cycling through some of Ireland’s most stunning scenery, chef Neven Maguire explores established Greenways such as The Great Western Greenway in Mayo, The Limerick, Waterford and Royal Canal Greenways; and he follows the routes of future Greenways planned for South Kerry and Connemara in Co. Galway. Along the way Neven meets some of Ireland’s most talented food producers and chefs in a variety of interesting locations. Ireland’s Greenways follow the routes of abandoned railway lines and canals which have been revitalised as cycling and walking tracks, passing through dramatic mountainous landscapes, lakeshores and seascapes. On his travels Neven also meets local historians who tell him all about these 19th century feats of engineering which had a transformative impact on the whole country. Many of the original aqueducts, viaducts and tunnels form part of the Greenways today and feature in the series.

programme.desc: Deserts. Forests. Caves. Mountains. How have human beings adapted to living in the world’s most extraordinary environments? The sheer magnificence of the natural world takes centre stage in this exploration of some of Earth’s most beautiful and most unforgiving environments and the people who have, against the odds, made these places their home.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: We start our trip in the mountains of "La Sierra Nevada", in the city of Granada, Spain, a place where we can ski and which is only an hour away by car from the beach. We will visit the City of La Alhambra, a palatial complex and a great fortress. And we will delight ourselves with some of the most popular dishes of Spanish gastronomy, Iberian ham and the delicious cold soup "Gazpacho". Then in the "Mediterranean Sea", on the Island of Cyprus; we will find some of the oldest water wells in the world and the first archaeological remains of "Cyprus", which date back to the Neolithic period, more than 10,000 years ago. We will try Haloumi, a type of semi-hard, dry cheese that is made from a mixture of goat and sheep milk ideal for frying or grilling. And from this island in the "Middle East", we moved to one in the south of the United States of America, Key West, in the state of Florida, with its keys and beaches with crystal clear waters, the legendary Fort Jefferson and a historic Lighthouse.

programme.desc: La acción se calienta hacia el sur mientras el "Cowboy de Alabama" Hoyt Corkins busca escribir su nombre en los libros de registros al mudar su segundo título de WPT de carrera.

programme.title: WPT L.A. Poker Classic - Part 1
programme.desc: En Los Ángeles, el dinero significa poder y hay mucho poder en juego en la mesa final del clásico de póker de Los Ángeles, ya que el primer y segundo lugar ganan más de $ 1,000,000.

programme.title: World Poker Tour
programme.desc: El torneo WPT más grande del año se reduce a su último cuatro y la acción no se detiene desde la primera mano hasta la última.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: En la vida de Inmaculada y de Abril aparece un hombre que al parecer les hizo mucho da o en el pasado. Ellas reciben constantes amenazas por parte de este hombre llamado Salom n. Sin embargo, no pueden denunciarlo con la polic a porque todos se enterar an de un secreto que llevan bien guardado. Sof a le cuenta a Ivana que la mujer con la que Vespasiano tuvo un hijo es la Pelusa. Esto provoca un odio y una rabia enorme en la se ora. Cuando va a enfrentarse con Ruth, ella le niega todo. Igualmente, Ivana est dispuesta a hacer todo por saber la verdad sobre ese hijo. Mientras tanto, en la UDH siguen investigando en el caso de la viuda negra. Ahora apareci un nuevo hombre llamado Dennis. Para muchos l es el asesino; para otros, un c mplice de la viuda negra.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 54: Josefina trama venganza, B rbara persigue a Ramiro.
programme.desc: Socorro acepta la propuesta que le hace Salvador sobre pasar la vida juntos, aunque ambos reconocen que primero tienen que solucionar sus asuntos personales y eso tardar un buen tiempo. Josefina por su lado est tramando con Gonzalo la forma de da arle su relaci n a Salvador, ya que piensa vengarse de su falta de amor hacia ella, y para hacerlo pretende subirlo a la web y mantenerlo ocupado para que no pueda gozar de ning n minuto libre con su amada.Mientras Ramiro le confiesa a B rbara lo maravillosa que es ella para l, vemos c mo Manuel est destrozado y le llora a Pedro porque est seguro que B rbara no descansar hasta casarse con Ramiro lvarez Castillo.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 54: Ricardo y Gabriela: Amor Prohibido
programme.desc: Marisela conversa con Abril al revelarle a su amiga el motivo de su preocupaci n al saber a Ricardo y a Gabriela vinculados en una prohibida relaci n amorosa. Alfonso se muestra decidido a rehacer su vida teniendo como objetivo principal para llegar a formar una familia a Marisela y poder as redimir sus pecados al lado de la dulce muchacha. Ra l y Arelys disfrutan de la tranquilidad de su hogar tras haber logrado expulsar a Pantoja de sus vidas. Ricardo sinti ndose desesperado ante la posibilidad de llegar a perder a Gabriela por causa de sus m ltiples mentiras hace un compromiso de amor con la muchacha. en un bar cualquiera de la ciudad, Moncho se deja entusiasmar debido a la llegada de Im n al lugar,

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 97: R mulo herido, un amor imposible.
programme.desc: R mulo sigue esperando a Egle al frente de su casa, y est sumamente enojado. Pero lo que no sabe R mulo es que Egle est ya en su casa, en su cuarto preparada para acostarse y disfrutar de un buen libro mientras espera a Santiago. Mientras tanto Santiago se despide para irse a los brazos de Egle pero los all presente no lo quieren dejar ir de la fiesta, lo tratan de convencer pero sin ning n resultado, porque Santiago no se perder a por nada del mundo estar con su amada Egle. Cuando Santiago llega cerca de la casa de Egle se da cuenta que en las afueras est R mulo esperando y decide irse de all para evitarle problemas a Egle y a Lu s Fernando porque lo m s seguro es que termine cay ndose a golpe con R mulo. Gerson y Yuraima mientras bailan ven como Aureliano trata de conquistar a Dileidi. Aureliano sigue insistiendo y ella le dice que puede que ella se este enamorando de el de repente, Aureliano no le cree y la quiere besar pero en ese momento Dileidi se imagina a Lu s Fernando dici ndole algunas cosas y no puede besarlo. Mientras que en la fiesta que se esta celebrando en casa de Pascuita Felicita, Cristinita y Tatianita le pregunta a Aristigueta si es posible que un hombre aunque este con una mujer pueda querer a otra mujer a lo que Aristigueta lo confirma. Lu s Fernando que esta muy rom ntico con Mar a Gracia trata de besarla pero se imagina a Dileidi dici ndole que el en realidad lo que esta es enamorado de ella. Luego de eso Dileidi le cuenta a Yeniluz lo que paso y le confiesa que por m s que trata no puede besar a Aureliano. En casa de Gonzalo, Matilde trata de consolar a Ernesto por que su pap no fue a buscarlo y Doroteo invita a los que est n en la fiesta para armar ah mismo un grupo de m sica y cantar en vivo, pero Gonzalo propone mejor ir a casa de Monchito para estar todos completo, pero entre La Nena y Matilde los convencen para que mejor se queden all en casa de Gonzalo. En casa de Pascuita est Aristigueta queriendo ir a casa de Gonzalo para darle el feliz a o a la Nena, pero Tatianita se lo impide a toda costa junto a Pascuita. En eso llega La Nena y le reclama a Aristigueta su presencia all y lo invita a irse de inmediato de all saliendo de all la Nena para casa de Gonzalo. Mientras ella sale entra Santiago y todos lo reciben porque volvi . Betzaida esta muy preocupada porque R mulo no llega y Nancy su madre trata de consolarla. Santiago llama a Egle y le cuenta que no puede ir porque R mulo esta en la puerta de su casa. Egle no lo cree y se enfurece mucho y queda con Santiago en escaparse al d a siguiente. R mulo se da cuenta de que Egle si est en la casa y decide treparse por la reja de la casa. En ese momento Egle sale con dos tazas de caf y no lo consigue junto a su moto y se sorprende mucho al verlo encaramado en la reja y le grita su nombre, cay ndose al suelo y maltrat ndose un tobillo. Santiago en su casa le cuenta a su Abuelo todo lo que el hizo para no tener ning n altercado con R mulo y este le responde que ese fue un acto noble. Egle lleva a R mulo a una cl nica mientras el protesta y dice no tener nada, pero al revisarlo el doctor este decide tomarle radiograf as mientras Egle se ocupa de todos los tr mites, siempre dejando claro que ella no es la esposa de R mulo. Betzaida sigue muy preocupada porque no llega R mulo y su madre se preocupa tambi n. Gonzalo les dice a sus invitados que el hielo se acabo y que ahora si se tienen que ir a casa de Monchito. La Nena convence en forma amorosa a Doroteo para no ir all y le insin a que ella lo que quiere es estar a solas con el. En casa de La Nena, Tatianita le reclama a su padre todo lo que paso por culpa de el y este le pide perd n y se va al ba o. En ese momento llega La Nena con Doroteo y le inventa excusa para no quedarse all . Ya en casa de Monchito los que llegaron son recibidos con abrazos de Feliz a o y Matilde y Monchito se abrazan, pero son observados por Pascuita y Gonzalo. En casa de Gladis ella se encuentra muy animadamente hablando con Remedios, Gabito se preocupa porque piensa que pueden llegar a las manos y decide llevarse a Remedio. Aureliano sigue con la declaraci n de amor a Dileidi y le pide que le demuestre que ella est enamorada de el y le pide que la besa, pero Dileidi no puede. Aureliano se da cuenta y dice que el no puede estar con alguien que piense demasiado para besarlo. Lu s Fernando que est con Mar a Gracia lo nico que hace es hablar de Dileidi y Mar a Gracia se molesta. La Nena logra despedir a Doroteo en el ascensor con la promesa de verse al d a siguiente y aliviada porque Aristigueta y Doroteo no se encontraron pero lo que no sabe que cuando Doroteo esta en el ascensor se abren sus puertas en un piso y entra Aristigueta, salud ndose muy efusivamente y pregunt ndose que hacen all .

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 42: In s y la fortuna de Don Carlos
programme.desc: In s descubre en unos documentos que es la hija de Don Carlos Nu ez, no lo puede creer. Robert continua molesto por la actitud de su padre con In s por que ella no posee fortuna, ni apellido de renombre para ser su esposa. Martha le aclara a In s que Don Carlos no era su padre pero si era muy amigo de su padre y que este le dejo toda su fortuna a cargo para que luego se las entregaran. Reinaldo averigua cuales son las intenciones de Aldo para con su hermana Vicky. Martha le dice a In s que haga exigir sus derechos pero In s le pide que por favor calle, que ya llegar la hora de decirlo. Vicky entra en una crisis nerviosa y es hospitalizada en una cl nica.

programme.desc: Cuatro hermanos huyen para escapar de una orden judicial que los separaría.

programme.title: Autopista al Cielo
programme.desc: Un fiscal de distrito choca con un abogado que acepta a defender a un amigo acusado de robo.

programme.title: Autopista al Cielo
programme.desc: Mark regresa a Oakland para volver a ser oficial de policía y se reencuentra con su antiguo compañero.

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.sub-title: Bridgend to Maine and New Hampshire
programme.desc: James, Monica, and their families cannot believe how inspirational it was to taste flavors from Ireland after Catherine successfully prepares an incredible meal for them, followed by two deserts made from their mother Ann's own recipes.

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: After learning the secret behind Nikki's savory recipe for pork stuffed with prunes, Catherine travels from Wicklow to Gran Canaria where she prepares the much-adored dish for Nikki's sister, Jill, and explores the rugged Canary Islands.

programme.title: Grannies on Safari
programme.sub-title: South Africa: A Country of Cultural Mosaics
programme.desc: Pat and Regina embark to a rejuvenated South Africa and explore the cultural mosaic of this extraordinary country. Visit Cape Town, Durban, and Johannesburg, and stroll through museums and galleries. Meet artists, designers, musicians, everyday people, and visit a Zulu village.

programme.title: Grannies on Safari
programme.desc: This is glorious Cape Town. Experience the Cape of Good Hope and supple wine country. Board The Pride of Africa on Rovos Rail for a trip to Pretoria, and in Botswana, visit the set of the TV series The Ladies #1 Detective Agency. Also, meet Oodi Weavers, accompanied by cosmetic icon Marilyn Miglin.

programme.title: Culinary Travels With Dave Eckert
programme.sub-title: Napa Valley - Great Meals and Great Stays
programme.desc: Culinary Travels has found some incredible flavors in Napa Valley, California. We will be sampling the region's famous wines before discovering fresh cuisine at two luxury resorts.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: The Tippling Club pairs award-winning cuisine with world-class cocktails and pushes the limits of combining fresh ingredients with unique textures. Chef and Owner Ryan Clift's inspiring culinary journey shines through in Tippling's dishes.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Meet the genius behind Chef Nancy Silverton and witness her make one of her celebrated pizzas from scratch. Mario Batali provides sage advice for young chefs, and Wolfgang Puck and Greg Bess take you into their culinary world at Spago.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Gilles Marx prepares a few more of AMUZ Gourmet Restaurant's exceptionally flavorful dishes and shares how he became inspired to live and cook in beautiful Jakarta. Also, explore AMUZ's curated wine cellar.

programme.title: Primal Grill with Steven Raichlen
programme.desc: Seafood's briny flavor is best enhanced by the smoky heat of the grill.

programme.title: The New Environmentalists
programme.desc: Zambia and Eswatini (formerly Swaziland) represent two divergent strategies on environmentalism. Meet people from both countries and learn of the successes, failures, and sacrifices they experienced seeking environmental justice.

programme.title: Cuba, Embracing its Future
programme.desc: Cuban ingenuity and creativity are alive in Cuba's capital of Havana, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. A leading site for fashion and music, Havana is reconnecting with its past as a starlet. Santiago de Cuba, the birthplace of Cuban music, is also featured. Experience "La Cubania."

programme.title: The Silk Road
programme.desc: Travel to Liqian, located at the narrowest point of the Hexi Corridor. Legend states that Liqian is where descendants of Crassus' lost legions ended up. Next, visit the sprawling industrial metropolis of Lanzhou on the Yellow River, and sample an essential ingredient of Chinese culture - noodles.

programme.title: Great Destinations
programme.desc: The Indonesian archipelago is a vast region of islands, craters, dragons, and jungles. As we sweep across the Indian Ocean, we will travel from Sumatra to Sumba, and we will help you create an itinerary especially suited to your interests.

programme.title: Backroads Europe
programme.desc: Italy's Via Cassia once led north from Rome to Florence, finally joining the Via Aurelia at Luna (now Luni). As you meander northward along the ancient route, each unique location you visit, and the interesting people you meet there, speak vividly to the region's steeped history and culture.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: Best Parks to Escape the Crowds
programme.desc: Some of the best national parks attract thousands of spectators every day. If you're looking for a place to go where you won't bump elbows, then take a look at these solitary parks.

programme.title: Word Travels
programme.desc: Robin swims with dolphins while Julia hunts for worms.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.sub-title: The Heart of Morocco: The Center
programme.desc: We begin our journey in the Atlas Mountains before traveling onward to Fes, Khenifra, and Merzouga. As the topography changes, notice how the people, culture, and music also change as well. Experience the Sahara Desert under the stars.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Meet those who are keeping the roots of reggae strong. In St. Thomas we find hot young singer Tarrus Riley, outside of Kingston we visit reggae star Richie Spice, and we will also meet young singer Etana who blends reggae and neo-soul.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.sub-title: Yellow Roads of Italy - The Two Sicilies
programme.desc: This is your chance to experience the rich culture of Sicily. Music Voyager travels into the heart of Sicily where we will dine with royalty and toast the region's famous vineyards amid the shadows of Mount Etna.

programme.title: Ottolenghi's Mediterranean Island Feast
programme.desc: On the dreamy island of Mallorca, Yotam leaves the busy beaches behind and heads inland to search for authentic local cuisine and ingredients that inspire him to create a few culinary masterpieces of his own in the kitchen.

programme.title: Food Relay
programme.desc: Paige discovers how one river split Serbia's geography, history, and food. Belgrade is infused with Turkish influence, whereas Novi Sad's Austrian roots run deep. Will Paige successfully hunt the poultry required for a Thanksgiving meal?

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: Jeremy begins with Chili Oil Noodles, while Joe Swash seeks to master Kung Pao Chicken. Jeremy also receives a masterclass in filleting before firing up the catch of the day on the beach. His last dish is Peanut Butter French Toast.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: Chocolate & Coffee from Bean to Cup
programme.desc: In Mexico, hot chocolate and coffee are equally enjoyed. The Seasons of My Heart Cooking School explains the roasting process from two perspectives, while the Finca Las Nieves Coffee Plantation offers a look into organic coffee production.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Jorge Vallejo is among Mexico City's rare chefs. His food has inspired Rick and Deanne for many years, but what inspires Jorge? One word: Tacos. Rick follows Jorge on a taco tour, from Tacos Gus to Taqueria Los Cocuyos, it is taco time.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: "You are what you eat." Brillat Savarin's statement fuels Rick's tour of the 21 de Noviembre market in downtown Oaxaca. We uncover the incredibly rich culture of the market and its role in the daily lives and meals of the local population.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.sub-title: You Say Tomato, I Say Domata
programme.desc: Can anyone imagine Greek cuisine without the tomato? When the tomato first arrived in Greece, it was disparaged and feared. Diane reveals the origins of this basic food while cooking some of Greece's most satisfying tomato-based dishes.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Enjoy a picnic in a Naoussa vineyard where one noble grape dominates the table: the local Xinomavro. Learn how this delicious wine pairs with a wide variety of Greek cuisine, and how you can incorporate it into your family's Greek menu.

programme.title: Canada's National Parks
programme.desc: Explore a region famed for its hot springs, backcountry treks, and fantastic array of wildlife, and be treated to elegant dining, and chateaux retreats. Also, enjoy train rides aboard the Rocky Mountaineer, scenic drives along the Continental Divide, and Snocoach rides across treacherous ice fields.

programme.title: Moments in Time with Elia Locardi
programme.desc: Elia charters a boat to visit the unique village of Kampong Phluk with some friends. Often referred to as the floating village during the wet season, they have the rare opportunity to walk along and photograph the colorful homes.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.sub-title: Carnival in the Guadeloupe Islands: Part 2
programme.desc: It is time to officially celebrate Carnival. Mickela takes you from the morning celebrations of Mardi Gras to the festive parade that night with Waka Chire Band, followed by a powerful procession with Akiyo Mas Band on Ash Wednesday.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: In Uzbekistan, Mickela learns to play the doyra in Tashkent, visits the 700-year-old Siyob Bazaar along the ancient Silk Road in Samarkand, dances in the UNESCO World Heritage City of Bukhara, and shares a traditional dish of plov.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.sub-title: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam - Cu Chi: Part 1

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World

programme.desc: Omar disminuye los rumores de que El Señor de los Cielos está vivo. Paloma escapa de la casa presidencial. El primer mandatario le encarga a Casillas una macabra misión contra ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ninón llega al sitio donde tienen secuestrado a su hijo y, momentáneamente, le arruina el operativo de rescate a Aurelio. Casillas le pide a Dalvio que le haga un favor al presidente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En Marsella, Aurelio toma la iniciativa de atacar a Filemón y a los secuestradores de Leonardo. Alguien resulta herido. Colón y su equipo se enteran de que se están robando la droga decomisada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ismael, Raymundo, Chatarrero y sus secuaces recuperan toda la droga. La ubican en las naves robadas y la distribuyen. Dejan muchos muertos a su paso. Ninon revela su secreto a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica convence al presidente para que le conceda una audiencia a Pastrana. El español le propone a Terán una vida paradisíaca en el exilio, haciéndose doblemente millonario, pero con una condición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ismael lleva a Leonardo a casa de Rutila para esconderlo, pero no es bien recibido, ni por Rutila ni por Mónica. Les pide que lo ayuden a encontrar al Chema; Leonardo quiere conocerlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ahora que Casillas tocó el corazón de Niñón quiere saber la verdad, si ella mandó a matar a Pilar. Ella insiste en que no lo hizo, pero él no le cree. Rutila se niega a buscar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Paloma sufre un paro cardíaco y Omar piensa que murió, pero el médico le informa que la pudieron revivir. Cuando ella reacciona y le pregunta por qué la quiso matar, el presidente desata su ira.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos coinciden en Tenerife. Aurelio, la Madame y Alí, la Marina de España, la DEA y la Interpol. Hay nervios, pero Casillas sabe cómo rescatar las 30 toneladas de droga incautadas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio convence a Niñón que financie la renta de los aviones necesarios en España, para así recuperar el cargamento incautado.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony y Mónica hacen negocios con Doble 30 y piensan dejar a Ninón fuera. También planean el secuestro de su hijo. Le dieron instrucciones a Alí para proceder con el ataque.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ninón le pide a Aurelio que la ayude a encontrar a su hijo, secuestrado por orden de Tony Pastrana. Aurelio la apoya y le promete que lo van a encontrar con vida. El español juega sucio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar disminuye los rumores de que El Señor de los Cielos está vivo. Paloma escapa de la casa presidencial. El primer mandatario le encarga a Casillas una macabra misión contra ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Dalvio y sus hombres encuentran a Esperanza, Aurelio ordena que la eliminen. Aunque Dalvio no quiere atacar, Skinny dice que deberían hacerlo. Empieza el tiroteo. Hay varias bajas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Juan Carlos llega a la casa de Aurelio y él se sorprende. Ismael se entera que el padre de Esperanza logró dar con ellos. Casillas quiere saber cómo lo hizo. Javi anhela un hijo con Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Juan Carlos le explica a Aurelio cómo llegó hasta él y Casillas trata de saber si le dice la verdad. Salvatierra propone pagar por el rescate de Esperanza. Mientras hablan, secuestran a Pina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio hace un recuento de todos los muertos que lleva en su conciencia. Cree que llegó la hora de deshacerse de alguien más. Por su traición, ahora Mónica teme que Casillas le quite a Isidro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras ser descubierta la casa de seguridad, Aurelio ordena evacuarla. Mónica trata de llevarse a Isidro con ella, pero es detenida por Ninón; ambas discuten. Robles es forzada a dejar al niño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Teran lo compromete.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y sus secuaces observan a Tony y Esperanza. Casillas lleva a Pina y a Juan Carlos para el intercambio por su hija e ignora sus súplicas. Castillo y Colón van al punto de la negociación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Salvatierra y Salazar llegan en helicóptero a rescatar a Esperanza, pero algo sale mal. Mónica termina su relación con Pastrana y jura acabar con Ninón, con tal de recuperar a su hijo, Isidro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javier y Rutila se enteran del plan de los colombianos, de no venderle más coca a los mexicanos y son encerrados por Quezada. Pretenden deshacerse de ellos. Leandro quiere una alianza con Tony.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.desc: Conversamos con Jerónimo Best, actor y productor de teatro que ha llevado su carrera a escenarios nacionales e internacionales, incluyendo la Royal Shakespeare Company en Reino Unido. Jerónimo nos comparte sus inicios en el teatro, la emoción de pisar escenarios legendarios y cómo la actuación, en inglés y en español, transforma la manera de sentir y comunicar emociones. Además, Jerónimo reflexiona sobre su labor como productor, traductor y adaptador de proyectos teatrales, así como la importancia de crear equipos actorales que funcionen como una familia. Con humor, sensibilidad y mucha pasión por el oficio, Jerónimo nos invita a mirar el teatro como un espacio donde la ficción detiene el tiempo y nos recuerda el poder de las historias para emocionar, unir y transformar.

programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: Sangre en la pradera
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Friedrich Gerstäcker, la película, ambientada íntegramente en el estado de Arkansas, cuenta el conflicto de intereses entre los habitantes de la ciudad y los colonos de las tierras circundantes, los mineros que llegaron durante la fiebre del oro, los vaqueros y los ladrones de ganado que causan problemas en la zona, y las tribus nativas de la región.

programme.title: El Coyote
programme.desc: En 1848 los EEUU se anexionan California, los hispanos son ahora discriminados por los yanquis. Para acabar con los abusos Don César ordena a su hijo estudiante que regrese de Europa. Los lugareños se ríen de este ridículo dandi. Pero no todo es lo que parece.

programme.title: Los cuatro salvajes

programme.title: Uno más al infierno
programme.desc: Johnny King, un vagabundo rebelde, se propone vengar la muerte de su mentor y amigo, Steve, después de haber sido asesinado por su tierra por los Hermanos Ward.

Enamorado de su hermana adoptiva y enfrentado a su hermano, también es acechado por un misterioso tío que busca venganza. A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

programme.title: Bienvenido, padre Murray
programme.desc: El padre Murray llega a Valley City, en la frontera con México; allí debe velar por la observancia de la moral, que últimamente está en decadencia. Sin embargo, como es un hombre negro, esto provoca la irritación de los habitantes del pueblo, que colgaron a un hombre negro por robo y asesinato hace varios años sin demostrar su culpabilidad sin lugar a dudas: el padre del sacerdote. El verdadero criminal, Ray Terris, ahora también hace todo lo posible para obstaculizar al sacerdote en el cumplimiento de su tarea, durante la cual también salen a la luz sus recientes planes de robo. Pero al final, la justicia triunfa.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.desc: Princess Peach sets off to save the Sparkle Theater from Grape and the Sour Bunch.
